title: New solar capacity and public subsidy in Mirenza, 2021-2025
bodyMd: The chart plots the solar generating capacity newly connected in the province of Mirenza in each of five years, measured in megawatts (MW). The figure for a year counts only the capacity added during that year, not the capacity already in place. The table beneath the chart also records the public subsidy paid out in each year, in millions of euros.

data.caption: Mirenza, 2021-2025: solar capacity newly connected each year, and public subsidy paid each year.

accessibilityText: A line chart with a supporting table covering five years, 2021 to 2025. The horizontal axis is the year and the vertical axis is the solar capacity newly connected during that year, in megawatts. The line rises every year: 2021, 40 megawatts; 2022, 60 megawatts; 2023, 100 megawatts; 2024, 120 megawatts; 2025, 170 megawatts. A second column of the table gives the public subsidy paid in each year, in millions of euros: 2021, 30 million; 2022, 36 million; 2023, 35 million; 2024, 30 million; 2025, 17 million. Over the five years 490 megawatts were connected in total and 148 million euros of subsidy were paid.

provenance.notes: Invented data for a fictional province, written for this item set. Capacity figures were chosen so that every year-on-year ratio a question asks for resolves by hand, and the subsidy column is deliberately present but not needed for the accompanying item, so that the candidate must separate critical from superfluous information. Not derived from any real dataset or published test item.
